description: Imports an eth proof-owner key from a file the developer already holds. Reads the raw 0x-hex key from `keyFile` and writes it to the project `.env` as RECLAIM_PRIVATE_KEY (mode 0600; `.env` added to .gitignore). Returns the derived address and the `.env` path; never the key. The key is a local signing key only: it is not registered with any server and is unrelated to org auth or encryption. To create a new key instead, use `issue_credentials`.

keyFile.description: Path to a file containing the raw 0x-hex private key (absolute or relative to the working directory).

projectDir.description: Project directory whose `.env` the key is written to. Defaults to the closest ancestor of cwd containing .git or package.json.

name: import_credentials
